skills.name: Gale (疾风)
skills.description:
Sakura attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.
''(While Sakura is in her 3rd skin, this skill changes to The Windy.)''

skills.name: The Windy (风/風)
skills.description:
Sakura attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.
''(While Sakura is in her 1st or 2nd skin, this skill changes to Gale.)''

skills.name: Mirage (幻影)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the start of battle and Sakura's turns, she gains 5 Magical Power stacks. Whenever an ally attacks an enemy with less than 65% of their initial HP, she consumes 1 Magical Power stack to use The Dream card and has a 20% base chance of Morphing them into a Mirage, lasts for 1 turn.
''(While Sakura is in her 3rd skin, this skill changes to The Dream.)'' ;Magical Power (魔力) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Can consume stacks to Morph enemies into Mirages. For each stack consumed, she gains a shield equal to 4% of her max HP, lasts for 2 turns. ;Mirage (幻影) : :Sakura's Morph effect. Unable to take actions, shikigami's passive skill loses effect, cannot be dispelled. Exclusive effect: Whenever an enemy is Morphed into a Mirage, all allies permanently gain 15 DEF ignore.

upgrades.text: If the enemy is a monster, the base chance increases to 50%.
